home.introText: Discover Morocco with our 4x4 rental service in Marrakech. Whether you explore the streets of Marrakech, the Atlas Mountains or the Sahara Desert, we have the perfect vehicle for your trip.

features.d: Our vehicles are reliable and versatile, perfect for dunes, mountain roads and city streets.
Competitive rates with no hidden fees, flexible packages and great value for money.
Our team is available 24/7 for your booking and for assistance on the road.
Daily, weekly or long-term rentals to suit your travel plans.

Well-maintained vehicles equipped with airbags, GPS and emergency kits.

sections.t: Explore the Sahara with our 4x4 rentals

Set off on the winding roads of Morocco's Atlas Mountains. Mountain passes and hidden valleys are easy with a reliable 4x4.

home.ctaTitle: Your next journey starts with the right car.
home.historyText: We provide high-quality 4x4 and car rental throughout Morocco. Whether you plan an adventure across the Sahara, a visit to Marrakech or a drive through the Atlas Mountains, our reliable fleet and service will elevate your trip.

faq.q: How can I find the best deals on car rentals at Marrakech Airport?
faq.a: Compare offers directly on our website: prices are listed per day with no hidden fees.

faq.q: What documents are required to rent a car?
faq.a: A valid driving licence, an ID or passport and a card for the security deposit. The minimum age is 21.
Drive on the right, wear your seatbelt, do not use your phone while driving and respect speed limits.
Basic insurance is included, with partial collision coverage and theft protection. The excess (franchise) is blocked on your card.

faq.q: Where can I pick up or return the vehicle?
faq.a: Most pick-ups are at the airport terminal. We also deliver to your hotel or home in Marrakech for free.
Pick up and return the car with the same fuel level.

faq.q: How much does it cost to rent a car in Marrakech?
faq.a: Prices start at €20 per day depending on the season and the vehicle.

faq.q: Any tips for a smooth rental?
faq.a: Book early, read the rental terms, inspect the car before driving off and drive responsibly.

about.text: We specialise in 4x4 and car rental across Morocco. Our team delivers vehicles to the airport, your hotel or your home, and supports you 24/7 during your trip.

conditions.title: Rental conditions
items: Minimum age: 21 years. Drivers under 25 may be subject to a young-driver fee.
A valid driving licence (held for at least 1 year) and an ID or passport are required.
A security deposit is blocked on a debit or credit card at pick-up and released at return.
Fuel policy: same level at pick-up and return.
Free cancellation, no prepayment: payment is made at the agency.
Partial collision coverage and theft protection are included. The excess (franchise) depends on the vehicle.
Driving off the road is only allowed with 4x4 vehicles and at the driver's own risk.
